request.goal_description: Sub-1:30 half marathon with strength and cycling, want to stay injury free
request.notes: Mostly flat roads. Mild left achilles tightness last spring.

plan.summary: A ten-week plan that builds from your current 40 km with three base weeks, then adds threshold and interval work before a two-week taper. Volume steps back every fourth week to protect the achilles. Two short strength sessions sit on the hard run days, and one easy ride replaces some easy volume.
warnings: Your goal (VDOT 51.0) is well above your current fitness (VDOT 46.5) for a 10-week build; treat 1:30 as a stretch target.
